rationale: CIPHERMATCH accelerates HE-based exact string matching with a data-packing algorithm and a proposed in-flash processing architecture. The main contribution is cryptographic algorithm/storage hardware co-design rather than a software compute kernel, kernel compiler, or kernel-level optimization for existing ML workloads.

LeanAttention is an exact attention execution mechanism for transformer decode that uses Stream-K-style partitioning to balance work and reach high GPU occupancy. It is directly an attention-kernel scheduling/layout optimization evaluated against FlashDecoding and FlashInfer.

UniNTT is a multi-GPU Number Theoretic Transform algorithm for zero-knowledge proof generation. NTT is a compute kernel, and the contribution decomposes/schedules it across warp, block, GPU, and multi-GPU hierarchy to reduce communication.

Mosaic is a deep-learning compiler that tessellates tensor computations into heterogeneous hardware instructions using the iTex abstraction. The contribution generates optimized operator kernels/instruction schedules and is evaluated on DNN and LLM operators.

BlockDepend is an ML compiler framework that extracts block-level dependencies to expose inter-operator parallelism and targeted GPU optimizations. Because its contribution is compiler analysis enabling lower-level operator scheduling/fusion, it fits kernel-style compiler work.

Orion translates PyTorch neural networks into FHE programs and contributes single-shot multiplexed packing for convolutions plus automatic bootstrap placement. This is low-level compiler/data-layout work for encrypted neural operators, but it targets FHE program construction rather than conventional GPU/CPU kernels.

COMET realizes W4A4KV4 LLM serving and explicitly develops a W4Ax mixed-precision matrix-multiplication kernel. The paper also introduces a mixed-precision data layout and SM scheduling to make the low-bit format efficient on GPUs.

MiLo is an extreme quantization method for MoE inference that includes Tensor Core-friendly 3-bit/W3A16 GEMM kernels. The paper evaluates both model quality and measured latency of these low-bit kernels.

The paper optimizes TFHE computation on processing-in-DRAM by analyzing data affinity and using an offline scheduler to minimize remote data accesses while preserving parallelism. This is a low-level scheduling/layout optimization for cryptographic kernels on a PIM accelerator.

FastTree introduces GPU attention kernels tailored to radix-tree KV-cache sharing and a runtime that chooses context-query groups for efficient execution. The evaluation benchmarks Triton attention kernels and end-to-end LLM serving throughput.

Relax is an ML compiler abstraction spanning computational graphs, loop-level tensor programs, and external library calls. Its cross-level IR enables operator fusion, tensor-program optimizations, and code generation for dynamic-shape ML/LLM deployment.

The paper generalizes DNN computation-reuse patterns via row/column reordering in matrix views and analytical latency/accuracy models for microcontroller inference. This is a data-layout/scheduling optimization for resource-constrained DNN operator execution.
